name: Mamibot W120-DP
description: Mamibot's flagship window-cleaning robot (marketed as "iGLASSBOT W120-DP"), using air-pressure adhesion rather than vacuum suction, with a built-in UPS backup and a mandatory safety-rope requirement in its own manual.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: Unlike most window robots, the W120-DP holds to glass via air-pressure adhesion (not vacuum suction), backed by pressure and photoelectric edge sensors, a gyroscope, and anti-fall detection. Mamibot's own user manual explicitly requires tying a safety rope to an indoor fixture before use — a manual requirement, not just a marketed accessory.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Mamibot markets this model simply as the W120-DP (also branded "iGLASSBOT W120-DP") across its own site, user manual, and all retail listings — no "-WB" or similar suffix appears in any official or retail source.

firmwareCommunity.note: Mamibot W120-DP has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
